name: Balochi (Southern)
notes: Southern Balochi, CROSS-SCRIPT (Arabic + Roman). Authored from Jahani & Korn (2009) + Korn (2005a). Cross-script LEXICON (balochi-lexicon.tsv, 399 words: 55 curated + 344 from Korn Etymological Index; ASJP-corroborated) recovers the vowels the Arabic abjad loses (short a/i/u unwritten + و/ی conflate uː/oː, iː/eː); Roman orthography is phonemic. Independent referee = ASJP Southern-Balochi bcc (CC0, coarse ~40w) corroborates the inventory ~97%. Fills the RETROFLEX-Iranian gap (ʈ ɖ ɽ vs dental t̪ d̪; ق->k; unaspirated). Arabic-OOV still skeleton-defective (⛔ tail); lexicon+Roman full-voweled. 🔷 single-referee-family.

name: Hebrew
notes: Modern Israeli Hebrew, the abjad. IN DEVELOPMENT (Phase 1). Sheva-na (native prefixes) needs morphology→Phase 2. Numbers deferred.

name: Kikuyu (Gikuyu)
notes: Largest language of Kenya. Pure greedy g2p from the Latin orthography (no code rules — fricativization + prenasalization in the table). 99.4% folded vs en.wiktionary Kikuyu (1062w — LARGE human referee, the fleet's highest folded score), single-source. Signatures: 7-vowel ATR (TILDE=quality not nasal: ⟨ĩ⟩=e, ⟨ũ⟩=o, ⟨e⟩=ɛ, ⟨o⟩=ɔ), fricativization ⟨b⟩=β/⟨th⟩=ð/⟨g⟩=ɣ/⟨c⟩=ɕ, prenasal ⟨mb nd nj ng⟩, ⟨ng'⟩=ŋ, ⟨ny⟩=ɲ, ⟨r⟩=ɾ. Dahl's Law orthographic (no rule). Tone (H/L+downstep) unwritten→not emitted. Numbers deferred. Referee built by tools/corpus/build-referee.ts (batched). Englebretson sketch grammar + Wahome & Subiyanto (2023) corroborate (both phoneme tables confirm ⟨ĩ⟩=e/⟨ũ⟩=o).
